scope: All PLA/PETG families indexed in BambuStudio color registry, including potentially historical listings. Registry presence is not proof of current retail availability.
notes: Official 8-digit RGBA swatches preserved, alpha is a display hint rather than measured volume transmission.
Gradient/multicolor variants retain all swatches without falsely presenting a single solid HEX.
Visual finish presets are uncalibrated estimates, not measured manufacturer optics.
